cases.rationale: The street contains numerous actual motorcycle riders and other people, multiple identifiable motorcycles, a passenger-car front at the left edge, and hanging traffic-signal heads. The motorcycles have motorbike bodies rather than pedal-bicycle frames. Storefront signs and poles supply no identifiable stop sign or parking meter; the visible carried or strapped material does not show a distinct category bag. After considering all 75 definitions across the whole crop, no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Two parked motor scooters are identifiable by their saddle seats, enclosed motor bodies, wheels and handlebars; a further scooter portion is cropped on the right. They qualify as motorcycles, with no pedal bicycle or actual person visible. The central pole and background fencing are not signal assemblies or category furniture. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

An actual hand and clothed torso are visible above an assortment of desserts, including clearly layered rectangular chocolate cake portions. The round glazed pastries are not identifiable doughnuts, and the flat serving plate is not a bowl. A small dark implement partly obscured by the hand and cakes could be a knife or a different serving/decorative item; the blade and handle cannot be resolved, so knife remains unclear. The glass display/counter does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were considered.

A long red articulated road bus occupies the foreground, passenger cars queue at the right, and small actual pedestrians are visible beside that traffic. The tower has a clear circular clock face with hands and hour markings. The bus is a road vehicle rather than a rail train, and the building's decoration is not a category object. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

Two foreground athletes and several background people are visible. Passenger cars can be identified inside the parking structure, and an upright blue drink bottle with a narrow top is on the grass at the right. No flying disc is actually visible despite the reaching sporting pose. Red/black and dark bag-like belongings on the sideline have inadequate detail to separate backpacks from carried shoulder/sports bags or loose belongings; backpack and handbag remain unclear. All 75 definitions were considered.

An actual giraffe is identifiable by its long neck, head, ossicones, legs and patch-patterned body behind enclosure rails. The enclosure, building, branches and unpotted trees provide no additional category object; the giraffe is distinct from the other animal definitions. All 75 definitions were considered and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A cropped human torso, hand and legs ride an actual skateboard, whose deck, trucks and small wheels are visible above the handrail. A leafy plant stands in the tall red-and-white planter behind the rider, supplying plant-and-container evidence. The staircase rails are neither bicycle parts nor category furniture, and the board's wheeled structure excludes the other boards. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

Actual people sit in individual dark chairs around a craft work surface. A pair of scissors with two finger loops and projecting blades lies near the upper-left craft papers. The tabletop is identifiable as a work/craft table rather than an eating table. Visible glue sticks, squeeze tubes, markers and cut paper are not bottle-neck vessels, books, knives or toothbrushes. All 75 definitions were considered, with no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual person's face fills the crop and a white toothbrush with a bristled head touches the mouth. Wooden chair backs and a light dining tabletop appear behind the person. At the right edge, toasted bread with visible green filling identifies part of a sandwich; it is not a plain piece of bread or pizza. The toothbrush head distinguishes it from cutlery and other narrow handles. All 75 definitions were considered and no unresolved category ambiguity remains.

A yellow curved banana with a fruit stem is visible beside a bear-shaped stuffed toy in a dark outfit and hat. The toy counts as teddy bear, not an actual bear or person. The small dark/white neck detail cannot be distinguished as a bow tie versus costume collar or neckerchief, so tie is unclear. Teal upholstered support and cushion are visible, but the crop does not establish whether the furnishing is a single chair or sofa; chair and couch remain unclear. All 75 definitions were considered.

An adult and child are actual people; the adult wears a patterned necktie and holds an identifiable mobile phone for a mirror picture. Narrow-neck toiletry bottles stand behind them. The tiny cropped metallic/fixture detail at the lower-right edge could be part of a sink tap, but no clear basin or sufficiently complete tap assembly is visible, leaving sink unclear. The reflected people are actual people in the scene, whereas the phone's case graphic is not another category object. All 75 definitions were considered.

Two actual giraffes are visible in the sandy enclosure: one extends its long neck from the left doorway, while another is partly occluded by the vertical post at the right. Their long-necked bodies and patch patterns support giraffe identity. The railing, rocks, dead log and shed do not constitute any other defined category, and no additional animal is identifiable. All 75 definitions were considered; no unresolved category ambiguity remains.
